strings.Every audit compares a relay with the pr: Every audit compares a relay with the profile of the model it claims: context window, output limit, capabilities, identity and behavioral fingerprints. Browse the profiles here and add your own models — no YAML files or editable install needed. Your entries are stored in kb.db on this machine and used by the web UI and zing check alike.
strings.Let an AI assistant research the model,: Let an AI assistant research the model, then check its answer here before it is stored.
strings.Paste it into the AI assistant of your c: Paste it into the AI assistant of your choice. It answers with one YAML document.
strings.The check validates the schema and limit: The check validates the schema and limits, flags unsafe regular expressions, lists every prompt zing would send to relays, and shows which model ids would resolve differently. Nothing is stored until you save.
